title: A 5-Pound Vulture Cracks Ostrich Eggs Its Beak Can't Break
subject: egyptian vulture

scenes.text: This vulture weighs five pounds. It cracks eggs its beak can't.
Ostrich eggs have shells too thick for its beak. The egg is a feast it can't open.
So it picks up a stone and drops it on the egg, again and again, until the shell cracks.
Scientists tested it. Offered a pile of rocks, the vultures picked egg-shaped ones.
Chicks raised away from adults never saw it done, and still smashed eggs with rocks.
No teacher needed. A five-pound bird, a rock, and the biggest egg on Earth.

description:
The Egyptian vulture weighs only about five pounds, yet it breaks into ostrich eggs with a stone.
Researchers found that chicks raised without adults still smashed eggs with rocks, and that vultures preferred egg-shaped stones.
Which animal do you think is the smartest tool user?
first_comment: Which would you bet on: a vulture with a rock or an ostrich guarding its nest? Name another animal that uses tools.
